::: {.callout-note title="In Development"}
This is a working plan for the complete TEJ learning pathway. It will take time to make every module publicly available while classroom resources, citations, permissions, diagrams, accessibility, handouts, and source files are cleaned up. **Published** modules are ready to use. **Pilot** modules are being tested. **Planned** modules show the intended sequence.
:::

This page is generated from [`site/data/tej-curriculum.yml`](https://github.com/mrandrewandrade/tech-edu-resources/blob/codex/tej-electronics-library/site/data/tej-curriculum.yml). It contains curriculum-only information. It does not expose the teacher planning workbook, student numbers, aliases, scores, private notes, restricted Drive links, or teacher-only tracking tools.

## Status and access

- **Published:** a public classroom resource is available and ready to use.
- **Pilot:** a resource is being tested and may change.
- **In development:** active authoring or verification is underway.
- **Planned:** the module belongs in the intended sequence, but its classroom package is not complete.
- **Bonus:** optional enrichment or a specialized pathway.
- **Restricted source:** a source may be available through the teacher but is not redistributed publicly.

Access is recorded as **Public**, **Teacher only**, **Classroom restricted**, or **External official source**. A public roadmap record does not make a restricted source public.

## Source register

The roadmap uses original summaries and links to official or appropriately licensed sources. Copyrighted textbooks, teacher copies, source scans, and materials not cleared for redistribution remain outside the public repository.

<div class="tej-roadmap-table-scroll">

| Source ID | Source | Roadmap use | Access | Copyright or permissions note |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| ON-TEJ | [Ontario Technological Education, Grades 11 and 12](https://www.edu.gov.on.ca/eng/curriculum/secondary/2009teched1112curr.pdf) | Curriculum expectations and program framing | External official source | Link to the official source. Do not republish the document as site content. |
| GROWING-SUCCESS | [Growing Success](https://www.edu.gov.on.ca/eng/policyfunding/growSuccess.pdf) | Assessment and evaluation policy | External official source | Link to the official source. Summaries must be original. |
| AAC | [All About Circuits textbook](https://www.allaboutcircuits.com/textbook/) | Open electronics reference | External official source | Link to the source and verify page-level licence requirements before reuse. |
| CASIO-FX991 | [Casio fx-570ES PLUS and fx-991ES PLUS User&#x27;s Guide](https://www.casio.com/content/dam/casio/global/support/manuals/calculators/pdf/004-en/f/fx-570_991ES_PLUS_EN.pdf) | Calculator workflow and notation | External official source | Link to the official manual. Use original classroom explanations and screenshots only when permitted. |
| ISLP | [An Introduction to Statistical Learning with Python](https://www.statlearning.com/) | Teacher and reference source for the planned machine-learning pathway | External official source | Link to the official site. Do not copy or republish the textbook. |
| GOOGLE-MLCC | [Google Machine Learning Crash Course](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/crash-course/) | Supplementary interactive machine-learning material | External official source | Link to selected official modules and follow the source licence and attribution requirements. |
| GOOGLE-RECSYS | [Google Recommendation Systems](https://developers.google.com/machine-learning/recommendation) | Supplementary recommender-systems material | External official source | Link to the official course and follow the source licence and attribution requirements. |
| KARPATHY-ZERO-HERO | [Neural Networks - Zero to Hero](https://karpathy.ai/zero-to-hero.html) | Advanced reference after solid Python and introductory mathematics | External official source | Link to the official course. Do not imply it is a required beginner course. |
| GROB | Grob&#x27;s Basic Electronics, 12th edition | Teacher planning source for electronics sequencing and experiments | Classroom restricted | Classroom source available through the teacher. Do not upload scans or chapters publicly. |
| OPEN-CIRCUITS | Open Circuits | Restricted visual reference for component interiors | Classroom restricted | Classroom source available through the teacher. Use original diagrams or separately cleared assets publicly. |
| MAKE-ELECTRONICS | Make - Electronics | Teacher reference for hands-on build ideas | Classroom restricted | Classroom source available through the teacher. Do not publish copied pages or diagrams. |

</div>

## Remaining implementation backlog

Planned records still need lesson pages, verified citations, original diagrams, accessible handouts, teacher guides, slides, equipment checks, permissions review, and classroom testing. The status field must be updated only when that evidence exists.
